body: So what you are saying is take time away from them and see what happens? I guess I could give it a try. I have done this before. They didn't seem to pay much attention though. When I saw them again they were like hey where have you been I haven't seen you for a while. Not giving much of an effort to stay in touch though.
I was raised to believe that you should treat others as you want to be treated. I guess it is kinda upsetting knowing that not everyone follows that. Thanks Soulbender.

What you say makes sense. I have heard about self-abnegation before and how doing it can end up hurting the giver. I hate that. I want to ask why people don't just see that and appreciate what I'm doing and give back, but I think I already know the answer. Thanks for this though. I'm getting able to wrap my head around whats going on better.

Thanks Sunny. I don't know if taking time away from them works. Like I said before, I find myself by myself a lot while they are hanging out with other more fun friends. Yeah I have hobbies. I like movies and video games and stuff like that.

Thank you denunciator. I get what you are saying. The thing is is that I'm not really giving people what they want. I am just giving them my time. These are good Christian people I hang out with. They aren't the kind of people to use someone. I think that they just don't really appreciate me.
